jobs.description:
Your role
Do you enjoy working in a tax environment where accuracy and compliance matter? As a Tax Specialist, you will support VAT- and real-estate-tax-related compliance activities for Real Estate DACH, ensure high-quality data and documentation, and help deliver reconciliations, analyses and controls. In this role, you will support day-to-day tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements in the tax environment.

We’re looking for a Tax Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• support quarterly fair value updates, including changes in use, input VAT adjustments and subsidies
• review and validate property allocation ratios
• prepare quarterly VAT returns; review documentation and file supporting documents to ensure timely submission
• perform annual turnover reconciliations and support VAT analyses and audits
• support preparation of real estate capital gains tax statements
• support real estate tax processes
• support direct tax and administrative tasks (e.g., supporting documents, data preparation)
• support continuous improvement of VAT processes and controls

titleByLocale.en: Accounting & Reporting Specialist – Real Estate DACH (with German)

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers and keeping things running smoothly? As an Accounting & Reporting Specialist, you will support periodic closings/reporting, ensure high-quality data, and help deliver analyses, controls, and cash flow reviews. In this role, you will support daily tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements.

We’re looking for an Accounting & Reporting Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• accounting support and administration for various products (real estate funds, investment groups, mandates), including coordination with internal stakeholders
• create, review, and prepare analyses of key figures and statistics
• review cash flow statements and support liquidity planning
• perform control activities (e.g., completeness and plausibility checks, reconciliations, four-eyes controls) and document the results
• maintain and ensure the quality of data/baselines (e.g., master data, reporting parameters) in the relevant systems
• support periodic closings/reporting (monthly/quarterly/annually) and ad-hoc analyses
• contribute to process improvements and automation in the reporting and control environment

jobs.description:
Do you have a challenging mindset? Are you an innovative analytical thinker who likes to ‎question the status quo? Are you interested in quantitative risk modelling? Are you wondering where the limitations ‎of a model are?

We are looking for someone to:‎
• supervise and conducting independent validations of credit risk models in line with ‎current regulatory and internal policy frameworks:‎
• Collaborate with model developers and engage stakeholders across the ‎organization.‎
• Define validation scope based on model use case, complexity, and materiality.‎
• Lead the development and maintenance of validation standards and stay abreast of ‎regulatory and market developments.‎
• Evaluate the model risk, including model robustness analysis, identification of ‎limitations, and their assessment.‎
• Promote consistency in validation practices
• Guide and mentor junior validators.‎
• Drive internal initiatives

jobs.title: Investment Analytics & Automation Analyst – ETFs
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working in the fastest growing area of passive investments?
Are you highly motivated by financial markets and portfolio construction?
Do you enjoy working in a high performing, diverse and international team?
Do you have a flair for numbers and presenting to stakeholders and clients? Then this is the role for you!

UBS Asset Management is seeking an Investment Analytics & Automation Analyst – ETFs to join the ETF & Index Fund business which is one of the key growth areas of the company.
Index tracking investment solutions have been a core competence of UBS Asset Management for over 30 years.

Key tasks:
• monthly Analytics deliverables which requires running reports,
• maintaining and updating collateral material,
• performing in-depth analysis on products and competitor offerings,
• clearly articulate and present the findings of the analysis to internal,
• strong MS Office skills, in particular Excel and PowerPoint,
• programming skills, with R coding skills being highly advantageous,
• motivated to enhance and automate processes involving data and displaying results in reports and presentations,
• having a positive attitude and willingness to learn and contribute to a high-performance team.

You will be supporting the ETF & Index Fund Investment Analytics team

UBS has a long track record of specialising in a quality indexing approach, which has contributed to them being one of the fastest growing index managers globally. Assets under management across index strategies amount to more than USD 1tn and USD 170bn in ETFs (as at Q4 25).

jobs.title: Payment Investigator
jobs.description:
Your role

Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for an Operations Specialist who will be responsible for end-to-end processing of paper and electronic check items cleared through the Federal Reserve, including posting adjustments, researching discrepancies, and processing Fed returns. This role ensures timely, accurate settlement and strict compliance with Federal Reserve, Reg CC, and internal bank policies.

Key Responsibilities:
• Investigate and resolve client inquiries related to payment issues, including sanctions holds, returned funds, and payment cancellations.
• Monitor and manage payment queues, ensuring timely resolution of flagged or delayed transactions.
• Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Compliance, Operations, Risk) to resolve complex cases and escalate issues when necessary.
• Maintain accurate records of investigations and resolutions in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
• Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
• Support audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation and insights into investigation processes.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about operational risk and keen to understand how an Investment Bank manages it? Are you self-motivated, driven, and able to lead workstreams to meet deadlines? Do you have the confidence to constructively challenge processes and provide innovative solutions?

We’re looking for someone who can support the Investment Bank in its first-line control and operational risk management activities, specifically to:

• •support delivery of the first line non financial risk and supervisory framework across AMER Global Banking
• •act as a point of contact for risk, supervision and control matters, providing pragmatic, business aligned advice
• •oversee key non financial risk processes, including RCSAs, conflicts of interest and inducements registers, non financial risk events and issues, and remediation tracking
• •review and challenge risk and supervisory MI, escalating material issues and employee conduct incidents as appropriate
• •responsibility to lead local regulatory and audit exams, representing GB BRM
• •build strong relationships with Global Banking senior management and control partners, and present at relevant governance forums

jobs.title: UGM Business Manager
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in fast-paced, front-office environments where execution and collaboration drive results? Are you passionate about scaling businesses, improving efficiency, and enabling revenue growth?

We’re seeking a Business Manager to join the Unified Global Markets (UGM) COO team, supporting senior leadership across Sales and Trading to deliver strategic initiatives that enhance business performance and client outcomes. In this role, you’ll work side-by-side with front-office team members to streamline processes, scale the platform, and drive commercial momentum across asset classes.

You’ll act as a trusted partner to senior business heads – connecting strategic objectives with day-to-day execution, and helping shape how UGM grows and competes across the Americas

• •partner with members of the COO team and senior business leaders to execute strategic priorities that support growth, efficiency, and scalability across Sales and Trading
• •identify and drive front-to-back process improvements to enhance productivity, client responsiveness, and execution quality
• •support commercial initiatives to optimize the client experience, improve sales coverage models, and unlock new revenue opportunities
• •deliver data-driven insights to help leadership measure performance and make informed decisions
• •lead or coordinate cross-functional projects across Trading, Sales, COO, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams
• •anticipate business needs and proactively design solutions that improve speed to-market, platform scalability, and front-office efficiency
• •maintain awareness of operational and regulatory frameworks, ensuring strategic execution remains sound and sustainable

jobs.title: Director, FX Options Trader
jobs.description:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking a Director, FX Options Trader in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for a Director, FX Options Trader to:
• Provide market-making and risk management for all Foreign Exchange (FX) Options emerging market currency pairs to the UBS client franchise utilizing specialized knowledge of internally developed tools and systems, including Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas and Brokertron.
• Focus on specialized field of knowledge in FX Options emerging markets currency to maintain accurate volatility surfaces across all the currency pairs by considering client flows and interbank market trades. Manage client flow risks and inventory positions.
• Leverage advanced knowledge of Market Maker Gui and Bloomberg to produce regular trade ideas and market updates, build and manage relationships with clients and prospective clients. Engage in FX Options initiatives to increase the UBS footprint in the U.S. market with a focus on Latin America, and partner with Sales and Strategy teams within Global Markets to capitalize on FX Options opportunities within the U.S.
• Apply expert understanding of specialized knowledge of our internally developed tools including T-Pricer and Market Maker Gui to improve the UBS E-trading offering to our U.S. clients via customized pricing profiles and enhanced technology in FX Options emerging markets currency pairs.
• Support the FX Options Trading division to efficiently and effectively run business operations, while maintaining responsibility for over 50 FX Options volatility surfaces.

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001684. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary Range & Work Schedule: $225,000 to $275,000 /year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques

jobs.description:
We are seeking a quantitative trader/developer with experience in building data-driven trading systems to join our fixed income algorithmic trading team within UBS Global Markets. This is a fast paced and collaborative team specialized in the development and management of best-in-class automated strategies in the fixed income space.
The role will be focused on government bonds and Interest Rate Swaps with opportunities to work on other asset class within the fixed income space.

• Sit within the Global Markets principal e-trading business and develop next generation algorithmic trading solutions.
• You will be involved in every aspect of algorithmic trading: designing, back testing, implementing trading strategies and as well tracking performance.
• Operate within a high-performing, fast paced quant development team, whose goals are directly aligned to the business
• You will employ analysis to help optimize systematic quoting and risk management strategies.

You should possess strong analytical skills and a passion for financial markets but also be experienced in object-oriented programming preferably in Java. Proven experience in a similar role is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Credit Risk Officer/Analyst – Hedge Funds
jobs.description:
Are you independent and self-driven? Do you have sharp analytic skills? We’re looking for someone like that who can:
•evaluate counterparty credit risk of hedge funds and family offices based on solid understanding of the counterparty's risk profile, business environment, exposure, and financial performance as well as a number of other quantitative and qualitative measures of counterparty’ credit worthiness (This includes client due diligence via client visit or conference call)
• •prepare counterparty reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• •approve new trades or to make recommendations to higher authority levels within Credit
• •perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and portfolio deep dive when necessary.
• •participate in portfolio reviews to identify risk developments or concentrations
• •exercise judgment and escalate decisions of high-risk trades to higher authority levels, as needed
• •lead trading documentation negotiation including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage and Repo Agreements

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building scalable investment capabilities and platforms that serve the most sophisticated clients? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where you can drive strategic initiatives from concept to execution? Are you a detail-oriented leader who can manage complexity while keeping the client experience at the center?

As a Product Manager in the Wealth Management Portfolio Strategy & Multi-Asset Solutions team, you will support the US House View Discretionary Models business through a blend of analytical, client-facing, and reporting work. You will have the opportunity to engage with capital markets, asset allocation, and content creation in a portfolio management environment. Your clear communication skills and attention to detail will be critical in this role.

• Product Manager and key stakeholder- serve as primary point of contact for questions and inquiries related to the Multi asset retail business. This role may include fielding inquiries from internal and external partners and resolving them appropriately. Support relationships with the various US retail advisor sales channels.
• Presentation materials - point person for maintenance and development of client presentations (pitch books, factsheets, investment reviews, etc.) and marketing materials. This role will have a focus on the maintenance of House View Portfolio Fact Sheets, the performance track record, and SharePoint site for all supporting materials. You will be expected to create and update content (presentation slides, commentary, etc.) that incorporates timely market events and help better position the Models with internal and external stakeholders. You will be partnering with portfolio managers and other product managers to develop and revise materials as appropriate.
• Represent the team in internal strategic initiatives, new product launches and projects. Translate strategic goals into actionable plans, manage key milestones, and deliver executive-level updates.
• Model portfolio subject matter expert- draft portfolio commentary and other Models’ communications, analyze model portfolios (returns, risk, performance attribution, etc.), business-related analysis and other ad hoc requests.
• Collaborate with Relationship Managers, Portfolio Advisory, and Product Specialists to ensure the House View platform meets client and advisor needs.
• Competitive Analysis - gather and analyze the competitive advantages of our industry peers and their competitive products.
• Automation - identify inefficiencies and manual processes that could benefit from automation using AI tools and leveraging internal partners to help drive strategic initiatives and grow the business.
• Manage technology-related workstreams, including vendor coordination, testing, and implementation of House View specific enhancements.

jobs.title: Reporting and Automation Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data? Are you looking to drive key product and regulatory initiatives across banking products such as SBL, Mortgages, Cards and Deposits? We are looking for someone like that who will analyze product, Financial Advisor and client data, support product development, drive/support revenue-generating initiatives and work very closely with product management, control and support partners.
Key competencies and responsibilities include:

• Develop data-driven business insights and analytics to drive growth within Banking
• Key contributor to strategic initiatives and part of a team that works on business growth development initiatives
• Deliver insights and segmentation by leveraging various internal and external data to grow market share of banking products and services and support strategic banking decision making
• Use product/financial SME to demonstrate through reporting and analyses how the product area drives profitability and work to develop strategies to enhance revenues
• Develop and assist in various reporting initiatives and data analytics on banking initiatives
• Take an ownership role in product data capabilities and work within the team and with partners to ensure sound data governance and development frameworks
• Analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers
• Identify and interpret trends and patterns in datasets to construct recommendations for strategic/tactical sales plans
